name: Tibber API
tagline: Nordic/EU smart energy GraphQL API for live prices, consumption, and home devices
description: Tibber provides authenticated GraphQL access to account and home metadata, electricity prices, historical consumption and production, and real-time Pulse/Watty measurements via subscriptions. The published schema does not document operations for controlling EV chargers or smart plugs; connected-device data is offered separately through Tibber's Data API.

auth.details: Personal Access Token (Bearer) from developer portal; send Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY on GraphQL requests

rate_limits: No numeric HTTP request quota is published. Maximum 2 open WebSocket connections; clients must use jittered exponential backoff. Tibber recommends querying today/tomorrow prices only once daily and caching them.

example.request: curl -X POST https://api.tibber.com/v1-beta/gql -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "User-Agent: curl/8.7.1 MyTibberClient/1.0.0" -d '{"query":"{ viewer { name homes { id address { address1 city } } } }"}'

use_cases: get current electricity price for a home
fetch hourly price forecast for smart scheduling
read real-time power consumption for a home
list connected homes and devices for a user
control smart plugs or EV charger based on price
subscribe to live consumption or price updates via GraphQL
